records.subject: spec-guard-source
evidence: result:the v0.79.0 annotated tag resolves to merge commit 165df830d6631d735202b0fd63b888b2ebdd653d (pull request #382); merged==true and main==merge sha were checked as a separate step before tagging; the merge commit's tree is identical to the accepted branch tip
result:the push run of the CI on main for the merge commit (39223205656) passed on attempt 1
result:one release for one requirement (user decision 66): checkpoint-default-report (#381) and align-upstream-rules (#382) share 0.79.0; the version bump is only in #382

result:checkpoint-default-report: an untiered middle checkpoint is a report, the last checkpoint of the todo is a gate when untiered; module_stage.gate_checkpoints is the one criterion for the next gate, the final gate and /map --json gates; interface.json 1.4 notes that gates may be smaller than under 1.3

result:align-upstream-rules: in-scope fixes to an approved Spec during the build are recorded and approved with the final acceptance, only a change of scope, direction or a new trade-off stops; in-scope added tasks do not send the Plan back to pending; UI self-verification needs a record (page, expectation, observation, screenshot path) or UI-not-verified with a reason before a task is ticked, starting a local dev server and opening local pages are routine work, the separate human gate is gone; document suggestions at Spec review only when there is one; AC numbering is a recommendation and verify-artifacts no longer warns
result:verify-and-commit full tier (validate.sh, test-phase-guard.sh 418 cases, test-verify-artifacts.sh 72 cases, ShellCheck) passed under macOS /bin/bash
